pain_points.statement: Finance is significantly delayed on invoicing due to data discrepancies.
pain_points.source_excerpt: finance is 3 weeks behind on invoicing because the data never lines up.

pain_points.statement: A large amount of working capital is tied up in unbilled receivables.
pain_points.source_excerpt: $1.4M in working capital that's currently stuck in unbilled receivables.

desired_state.statement: The CFO wants a fixed-fee engagement with milestone-based payments.
desired_state.source_excerpt: fixed-fee proposal with milestone payments tied to specific outcomes

success_criteria.statement: The project must free up working capital by returning to a five-day DSO.
success_criteria.source_excerpt: return to five-day DSO from where we are now frees up about $1.4M

success_criteria.statement: The project should save costs by avoiding the need to hire additional dispatchers.
success_criteria.source_excerpt: we don't need to hire four additional dispatchers next year, which is about $320k

risks_unknowns.statement: There is a disagreement on the approved budget cap for Phase 1.
risks_unknowns.source_excerpt: the budget I approved is $300,000. That's the cap.
risks_unknowns.contradiction_note: Rita insists on a strict $300k cap, while Sarah claims they discussed a $250k to $400k range.

risks_unknowns.statement: Missing the ELD compliance deadline could result in fines or losing operating authority.
risks_unknowns.source_excerpt: Fines, possibly losing our operating authority in some states.

pain_points.statement: The custom dispatch tool is outdated and at the end of its useful life.
pain_points.source_excerpt: Routemaster is seven years old... and it's at the end of its useful life.

pain_points.statement: Technical debt makes the codebase fragile and slows down feature development.
pain_points.source_excerpt: We can't ship features anymore because the codebase is too fragile.

pain_points.statement: Drivers are highly dissatisfied with the current mobile application.

desired_state.statement: There is disagreement on whether to replace the dispatch platform or fix existing workflows.
desired_state.source_excerpt: Sarah thinks this is a workflow problem. I think this is a platform problem.
desired_state.contradiction_note: Marcus wants to replace Routemaster with a SaaS platform, while Sarah wants to incrementally fix workflows on the existing system.

desired_state.statement: The architecture should be designed so that workflow logic is portable to a future platform.
desired_state.source_excerpt: workflow logic in a layer on top of Routemaster... most of the workflow logic is portable.

success_criteria.statement: A majority of the Phase 1 work must survive a future platform change.
success_criteria.source_excerpt: I'd estimate 60-70% of the Phase 1 work survives a platform change.

risks_unknowns.statement: Previous internal attempts to fix the workflow issues have failed.
risks_unknowns.source_excerpt: We've tried internal projects to fix this exact thing twice and they both failed.

risks_unknowns.statement: Any changes to the driver app must coordinate with the separate ELD compliance work.
risks_unknowns.source_excerpt: If we're going to touch the driver app, the ELD work has to be coordinated.

pain_points.statement: Dispatchers suffer from excessive manual data entry between systems.
pain_points.source_excerpt: Too much manual entry between our custom dispatch tool and Salesforce

desired_state.statement: The operations team wants to incrementally fix specific workflow pain points.
desired_state.source_excerpt: fix three specific operational pain points... incrementally

success_criteria.statement: The project must achieve a 30% reduction in dispatch time per load.
success_criteria.source_excerpt: a 30% reduction in dispatch time per load

risks_unknowns.statement: There is disagreement on the feasibility of the Q3 pilot deadline.
risks_unknowns.source_excerpt: Q3 was your commitment, not mine. I never agreed to Q3.
risks_unknowns.contradiction_note: Rita and Sarah require a Q3 pilot for budget reasons, but Marcus believes Q4 is more realistic and never agreed to Q3.

pain_points.statement: Technology integration from recent acquisitions remains incomplete.
pain_points.source_excerpt: Tech integration from those acquisitions is incomplete.

desired_state.statement: The company must meet the upcoming federal ELD mandate update.
desired_state.source_excerpt: The ELD compliance deadline in November is real.

success_criteria.statement: The consulting engagement must not interfere with the ELD compliance workstream.
success_criteria.source_excerpt: whatever we build needs to not get in the way of the compliance work.

risks_unknowns.statement: The exact details of the ELD compliance mandate are currently unclear to the consulting team.
risks_unknowns.source_excerpt: details unclear, will be discussed on the call

risks_unknowns.statement: There is fundamental disagreement on whether to invest in a short-term fix or a long-term platform replacement.
risks_unknowns.source_excerpt: We're scoping a band-aid because we set a budget that only buys a band-aid.
risks_unknowns.contradiction_note: Marcus believes they are wasting money on a short-term fix for a dying platform, while Sarah and Rita are focused on immediate operational relief within a strict budget.
